resources.string: Argon certificates
Manage domains trusted by the built-in Russian root CA

The built-in Russian root CA is trusted only for enabled zones and domains you explicitly add. A domain entry also covers its subdomains. Public suffixes and wildcards cannot be added. Tap ! to see overlapping trust rules. Changes apply to new certificate checks.
